tweets.text:
Hats off to the men and women of U.S Customs and Border Protection (CBP). 

The Border Patrol and Office of Field Operations were not allowed to perform their national security mission for the entirety of the last administration.  Within hours of President Trump taking the oath of office you have excelled. Illegal border crossings on our southern border are down 95%.  Strong border security equates to stronger national security. We are a safer country because of your enduring service to this great nation. God bless you all for your dedication and love of country.  President Trump has unleashed thousands of patriots that will work tirelessly to make this nation safer every hour of every day.  President Trump’s vision and action on border security is unprecedented. 
~ Thomas D. Homan
    US Border Czar

tweets.text:
In response to Richard Angwin's comment in my last post:

You do not know what you are talking about. I see the reports every morning. Crossings are down 95%, based on actual data. That is a stone cold fact. Regarding your other comment, on average during the Biden Administration there was an average of more than 1,300 known got aways daily. As a matter of fact, in FY 2023 that amount was 1,800. In the last 24 hours we have had a total of 48. Also, when you talk about human costs, you failed to mention the more than a half million children separated from  their families and smuggled into this country by criminal cartels with 300,000 of them unaccounted for under Biden. The nearly 4,000 aliens that have died making the journey to our border under Biden, which is an historic number. The 600% increase in sex trafficking of women and young children and the quarter million young Americans dead from fentanyl under Biden. I can go on and on but don't have time to respond to every person that misrepresents the great work done every day by the men and women of the BP. While you sleep safe and secure in your bed every night, there are thousands of green and blue uniforms standing post, protecting this nation which protects you and your family.  I know because I wore that uniform. Again, I don't have the time to respond to every fake post so I will move on.
